decisions.reason: The superyacht crew recruitment service builds on existing crew recruitment capabilities and remains strategically aligned, so withdrawal risk is low.
The maritime education programme leverages the firm's training expertise and has a growing partner network, making it valuable.
Emissions monitoring and compliance services address regulatory demand and have demonstrated successful delivery, supporting retention.
The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and supports digitalisation, so it is likely to be kept.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool complements the dashboard and existing software, reducing its withdrawal risk.
